arguments.content: A [contact-redacted] / Greene Street Pharmaceuticals thread asset was developed in the ChatGPT relay loop. The operational framing is: transdermal CBD is a route-of-metabolism natural experiment. Greene Street’s CBD patch may separate parent-CBD exposure from the oral first-pass 7-OH/7-COOH metabolite cascade. The smallest useful measurement is not a comprehensive mechanism panel but a steady-state LC-MS/MS parent/metabolite fingerprint: CBD, 7-OH-CBD, and 7-COOH-CBD, with ratios 7-OH-CBD/CBD and 7-COOH-CBD/CBD, ideally tied to even crude symptom or tolerability outcomes. The likely existing asset is archived plasma or parent-CBD plasma PK; the key reanalysis is whether archived samples can be re-assayed for 7-OH-CBD and 7-COOH-CBD. Future instances should retrieve this if Frank reopens the conversation and should hold patient register: the proposal is stronger held in reserve than pushed prematurely.
